newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Feb 24.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Feb 24.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.
FRATERNITE MATIN
- Total of 290 children in youth wing of Abidjan's MACA prison,
mostly children found wandering in the streets, head of
children's right group BICE says
- Ivorian telecommunication agency ATCI gives all cellular
telephone users from February 24 to March 7 1997 to submit their
handsets for verification and registration; after the deadline
ATCI teams will confiscate all non-registered handsets
- Ivory Coast's Golf Hotel offers nation's first cyber cafe;
advertisement invites people to become members of associated
cyber club
- Britain to hold exhibition in Abidjan of English-language
teaching materials on February 28
LA VOIE

- President Henri Konan Bedie turns his home town of Daoukro into huge building site with a spate of construction projects - Newly privatised telecommunications company CI-TELCOM says in statement fault with under-sea cable causes problems with international lines; says it hopes full service will be restored in several days - Ivorian government invites tenders for two forest road

restoration projects -- 279 km (170 miles) in Duekoue and Danane districts and 285 km (180 miles) in Man and Biankouma districts. Only companies in African Development Bank member nations eligible. Closing date for bids April 1. Details from Projet de Developpement Rural de la Region Forestire Ouest tel: +225 21 55 33/21 08 21 Fax: 21 55 40.

- Experts hold workshops in capital Yamoussoukro on Ivorian rain forest -- tax regime for the timber industry and role of local communities in management of classified forest - Niger's minister of state for African integration, Sanoussi Jackou, a former opposition leader, says in interview that a fresh coup bid to be feared there; urges consensus solution
LE JOUR
- Ivorian electricity and gas trades union SYNASEG denounces intimidation and pressure on its activists by certain members of management of power company CIE

- West African Development Bank lends Ivory Coast 2.1 billion CFA francs to help business and rural development initiatives in centre and centre north of the nation - Sack maker FILTISAC becomes first Ivorian company and one of just a handful of African companies outside South Africa to win European Quality Certification Institute's quality certificates - Ivorian cellular telephone company Ivoiris says its network has reach Assinie, eastern weekend resort near border with Ghana - Ivory Coast's national soccer side The Elephants defeat Mali 2-1 away from home, improving their chances of qualifying for next year's African Nation's Cup finals in Burkina Faso.
($1=570 CFA francs) -- Abidjan newsroom +225 21 90 90
